title: Accelerated Benefit Provision — Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI)
content:
# Accelerated Benefit Provision — Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI)

**Provision.** An insured with a medically documented life expectancy of 9 months or less may receive up to 50 percent of the coverage in advance, once per policy; the rest is paid to the beneficiaries at death. An accelerated benefit is paid only on a policy whose status is active.

## Elements of the provision

| Element | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Who | the insured under the Veterans' Group Life Insurance (VGLI) policy |
| Medical condition | a medically documented life expectancy of 9 months or less |
| Largest amount | the policy's coverage amount multiplied by 50 percent |
| How often | once per policy |
| Policy status | active, as the system records it for that same policy |
| What remains | the rest of the coverage is paid to the beneficiaries at death |

The status test is made on the record of the policy the benefit would be paid from, before payment. Because the provision says *only* on an active policy, a policy in any other status — issued, grace, lapsed, cancelled, converted or matured — is not paid an accelerated benefit.

## Largest accelerated benefit by tier

The largest amount is the tier's coverage amount multiplied by 50 percent:

| Coverage tier | Coverage | Largest accelerated benefit |
|---|---|---|
| VGLI $50,000 Coverage | $50,000 | $25,000 |
| VGLI $100,000 Coverage | $100,000 | $50,000 |
| VGLI $200,000 Coverage | $200,000 | $100,000 |
| VGLI $300,000 Coverage | $300,000 | $150,000 |
| VGLI $400,000 Coverage | $400,000 | $200,000 |
| VGLI $500,000 Coverage | $500,000 | $250,000 |

## Cases (hypothetical insureds)

| Policy status | Documented life expectancy | Accelerated benefit already paid on this policy | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | 6 months | none | may receive up to 50 percent of the coverage |
| active | 9 months | none | may receive up to 50 percent of the coverage; 9 months is within "9 months or less" |
| grace | 6 months | none | not paid; the policy is not active |
| lapsed | 4 months | none | not paid; the policy is not active |
| active | 5 months | yes | not paid again; the benefit is once per policy |

*Hypothetical:* an insured holding VGLI $200,000 Coverage, policy active, life expectancy documented at 7 months, receives an accelerated benefit of $100,000 (the largest amount for that tier). The remaining $100,000 of coverage is paid to the beneficiaries at death.

## Basis questions

- *Can the insured take 30 percent now and another 20 percent later?* No. The benefit is paid once per policy, up to 50 percent of the coverage.
- *Is the benefit payable while a premium is overdue and the policy is in its grace period?* No. It is paid only on a policy whose status is active.
